topic_title: Law and Purpose of Vehicle Lighting Equipment
prompt: Why should drivers use low beams or specialized fog lamps rather than high beams during heavy fog?

options.text: High beams consume excessive electrical alternator wattage in cold moist air
Fog droplets will fracture the glass lenses of halogen high-beam bulbs
High beams are illegal on Texas state roadways whenever fog is present
High beams reflect off airborne fog water droplets, blinding the driver with glare
